meta.title: Retry failed charges with backoff
meta.head: retry-backoff
meta.pr: payments-svc #482: make payments resilient to provider outages

C1.label: verified
C1.claim: `Charge` now sends the request again, up to `MaxRetries` more times, when the call errors or the status is 500 or above.

C2.label: verified
C2.claim: `backoff` doubles the delay on each attempt (`base << attempt`) and caps it at 30 seconds.

C3.label: verified
C3.claim: `Config` gains two fields, `MaxRetries` and `BaseDelay`; their defaults (3 and 200ms) are written in comments, not enforced in this diff.

C4.label: inferred
C4.claim: `Charge` retries a POST that carries no idempotency key, so a retry after a lost response could charge twice.
C4.why: Lines 23 and 24 resend the same `newPost` request on every pass, and the diff sets no key or header on it (lines 21-28).

C5.label: verified
C5.claim: `TestChargeRetriesThenSucceeds` covers a server that fails 2 times with 503 and then answers 200.

C5b.label: inferred
C5b.claim: No test in the diff covers retries running out, or a 4xx response.
C5b.why: The only test added is lines 16-22 of client_test.go; it ends in success. The older `TestChargeOK` sets no retry settings.

C6.label: stated
C6.claim: The PR title says payments are now resilient to provider outages. The code retries only transient errors, with waits of up to 30 seconds; it does not queue or replay.

C7.label: unverified
C7.claim: Whether the payment provider deduplicates repeated charges is not visible in this repository.

C8.label: verified
C8.claim: checkout.go changes whitespace only: the tokens before and after are identical.

C9.label: inferred
C9.claim: The payment client now absorbs short provider outages inside one `Charge` call, so callers wait longer before an error (up to roughly the sum of the delays).
C9.why: From C1 (the loop) and C2 (the delays): the loop sleeps between attempts before it returns an error.

hunks.text: Charge: single call replaced by a retry loop; new helper backoff
one new test: retries then succeeds
two retry settings added to Config

symbols.name: Charge
symbols.before: Sends one request; returns the first error.
symbols.after: Retries on error or 5xx, sleeping between attempts, then returns the last error.

components.name: payment client
components.desc: Charges now survive brief provider errors by retrying with a capped delay. Callers can wait much longer before an error.

change.purpose: Make the payment client retry failed charges with a capped, doubling delay. It touches one component and does not change what callers send.

flow.text: checkout -> `Charge` -> provider. Now: on error or 5xx, wait and resend, up to `MaxRetries` times, then return the last error.

cohorts.name: Retry failed charges
cohorts.why: One purpose: a charge that hits a transient error is resent after a growing delay.

cohorts.name: Formatting only
cohorts.why: No behaviour change; folded by default.

Y1.title: Retry settings
Y1.order: Read first: the later layers read these two values.
Y1.sum: Adds two settings, MaxRetries and BaseDelay. Their defaults are only in comments.

Y2.title: Delay between attempts
Y2.order: Second: Charge calls it, so read it before Charge.
Y2.sum: A new helper doubles the wait on each attempt and caps it at 30 seconds.

Y3.title: Charge retries
Y3.order: Third: composes layers 1 and 2. This is where the purpose of the change lives.
Y3.sum: Charge now resends on error or 5xx, waiting between tries. Callers can wait much longer, and a retry could charge twice.

Y4.title: Test and what is not known
Y4.order: Last in the cohort: what the test covers and what it does not.
Y4.sum: One test covers fail-twice-then-succeed. Running out of retries and 4xx are untested; provider dedup is unknown.

Y5.title: Whitespace in checkout
Y5.order: Separate cohort, no link to the retry change.
